eligibility.quote: The transformed quaternion wasn't being passed to set_attitude_target(), resulting in an incorrect attitude setpoint. I've now fixed this issue.

failed_conditions.quote: Eigen::Map<Quaternionf> place data in xyzw order instead of wxyz.

loudness.quote: Have you flight-tested this? The fix looks correct on the math level, but we need a system-level verification as well.

resolution.quote: Yes. Flew with this code yesterday. I've verified that it now behaves the same as release 0.12.0

notes: Representation convention error: Eigen internal quaternion memory layout is [x, y, z, w], whereas MAVLink wire protocol SET_ATTITUDE_TARGET quaternion field expects [w, x, y, z] component ordering.
